criteria.criterion: When every task is done, the final pass passes and run.verify is true, the driver clears .vloop/tmp/ (all but .running) and runs one session of phase `verify` with `/vloop:verify` and no argument, model.verify and effort.verify resolved, before the run commit. A resume with every task done repeats the final pass, then the verify session. With run.verify = false nothing of it happens and nothing is printed for it.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/iterate.go verifySession: run.verify check, clearTmp, resolved model/effort; called at iterate.go:236. TestRunVerifyOnResume and TestRunVerifyOff cover resume and off.

criteria.criterion: The session runs under its own fence, fence/verify.json, which allows exactly what the review fence allows. What it changes outside .vloop/tmp/ is reverted as a review session's is, printing `vloop: the verify session changed <path> — reverted` per path, and its report is still kept; a change the driver cannot revert halts the run as for a review session; refs, .git/config and hooks are guarded as for every session (exit 9).
criteria.evidence: iterate.go verifySession reverts, warns per path, halts on failed revert; internal/cli/fence_test.go lists verify with review's permissions; TestRunVerifyRevertsChanges and TestRunVerifyMovesRef (exit 9).

criteria.criterion: A valid .vloop/tmp/verify.json (verify/v1) is kept as <run dir>reports/verify.json and announced as `verify: <n> finding(s) — see <run dir>reports/verify.json`, or `verify: no findings` for an empty list. A missing or invalid report warns `vloop: the verify session left no valid .vloop/tmp/verify.json — verify by hand`; a session that fails to run or times out warns `vloop: the verify session failed to run — verify by hand; see <run dir>run.log`; with the cost ceiling already reached it warns `vloop: cost ceiling reached — verify skipped` and starts no session. In every case the run ends complete, exit 0.
criteria.evidence: iterate.go lines 830-885 emit each message; tests TestRunVerifyNoFindings, MissingAndInvalidReport, SessionFails, CostCeiling assert them with exit 0 and complete status.

criteria.criterion: A finding never changes the run's ending, its exit code, the plan's status or any task: no code path reads the findings to decide anything. A driver that blocks, fails or re-opens work on a finding is the violation.
criteria.evidence: verifySession only counts findings for the announcement; always returns nil after the report.

criteria.criterion: The record is sessions/NNN-verify.json, session/v2, iteration 0, no task; its cost counts toward the run's spend; the run commit holds it and reports/verify.json. `vloop status` names the phase `verify` while the session runs.
criteria.evidence: it.spent += res.Cost; TestRunVerifyStatusAndRecord checks 'running: verify for', session/v2, phase verify, iteration 0, no task.
